subject: RFP: tenancy isolation topology — SpiralBank evidence request
messages:
From: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@spiralbank.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@spiralbank.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2023 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SpiralBank RFP: topology evidence and isolation diagram request

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of the formal RFP packet our security team needs a concise topology diagram and a short summary of your tenancy/isolation model and threat mitigations. Specifically SpiralBank has asked for:

- Network topology diagram showing control plane / data plane demarcation and tenant egress paths.
- A 1-page threat model summary focused on lateral movement & egress controls.
- Proof artifacts: attestations or logs showing tenant separation (sanitized), and a list of controls around KV cache and sidecar isolation.

Can you confirm what we can provide by next Friday (Apr 7)? Also let us know if any artifacts require an NDA or redaction.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dupont
Security Procurement Lead
SpiralBank

[Attachment: SpiralBank_RFP_Template.docx (uploaded by SpiralBank)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@spiralbank.com>, Procurement <procure@spiralbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2023 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SpiralBank RFP: topology evidence and isolation diagram request

Hi Claire — appreciate the clear list.

We can provide a sanitized topology diagram and a one-page threat summary. I attached a draft diagram and our completed questionnaire to start the conversation (see attachments). A few clarifying questions so we scope the evidence packet correctly:

1) Do you need operator-level audit traces (full traces with operator identifiers) or is a redacted control-plane attestation sufficient?
2) For KV cache and sidecars, are you asking for configuration artifacts (YAML snippets) or high-level control descriptions and example logs?

We'll prepare a compact evidence bundle (sanitized) plus a short narrative tying controls to the threat scenarios you care about. If you confirm the scope we can aim to deliver an initial packet by Thu (Mar 30) and final deliverables by Fri (Apr 7).

I attached: isolation_topology_v1.png (draft diagram), spiral_rfp_questionnaire.pdf (completed answers).

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Mar 2023 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SpiralBank RFP: topology evidence and isolation diagram request

Connor — quick internal note after reviewing the draft diagram and questionnaire. High level: good start, a few changes I recommend before sending external.

- Diagram: add explicit demarcation of the private tenant enclave (sealed subnet) and label the control-plane management channel separately from data-plane flows. Remove IP-level details and any operator hostnames.
- Threat model (one-paragraph suggestion below):
  Redwood treats tenant isolation as a layered set of controls: strict process isolation in inference runtime, per-tenant KV namespaces with access policies, control-plane mutual TLS and token-bounded actions, and prefix/KV caching hygiene. Mitigations focus on removing shared secrets from runtime, circuit-breakers for anomalous token behaviour, and automated rollback to verified model variants to avoid poisoned prompts.
- Evidence packet: provide control-plane attestation (sanitized), ACL screenshots, and a sample KV namespace audit (redacted UIDs). Avoid sending raw logs with operator identifiers. I can assemble a sanitized evidence zip if Ben provides the baseline artifacts.

If Ben can pull the attestations and the ACL screenshots today I can produce the evidence_packet_zones.zip and the 1-page threat summary by EOD Thu.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security Architect | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
[Suggested text included in a doc: redwood_network_controlplane_note.docx]

Connor — thanks for jumping on this. Two quick asks from a commercial/contracting standpoint:

- Legal will want the evidence packet to exclude any PII and operator identifiers. If Kimberly is sanitizing, confirm that redaction checklist to Legal before sending externally.
- Procurement teams often appreciate a short cover note that maps each artifact to the RFP question number — include that as a one-paragraph index.

If Ben can prioritize the artifacts today we should be able to ship the external packet tomorrow (Thu). I support the plan to offer a 48-hour follow-up window for clarification calls.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Hi Claire — thanks for the patience. Attached is the sanitized packet we discussed and a one-page narrative that maps artifacts to your RFP items. Summary below and attachments/links at the bottom.

What we sent:
- isolation_topology_v1.png — sanitized topology diagram (control-plane vs data-plane labeled; no operator hostnames).
- one-page threat model summary (embedded in "redwood_network_controlplane_note.docx").
- evidence_packet_zones.zip — contains: control-plane attestation (redacted), ACL screenshots (sanitized), sample KV namespace audit (UIDs redacted).
- spiral_rfp_questionnaire.pdf — updated with a short index mapping artifacts to RFP questions.

Notes / clarifications you asked for:
- Operator-level traces: we provided a control-plane attestation and redacted audit snippets; full operator traces include identifiers and require an executed NDA/PII handling agreement.
- KV cache controls: included example audit snippet and configuration excerpts (sanitized) showing per-tenant namespaces and eviction policies.

Links / artifacts:
- Drive folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SpiralRFPdocs
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/HSB-6789
- DocuSign SLA placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/12345/spiralbank-sla

Next steps:
- If this looks good, can we schedule a 30-minute call next week to walk through the threat summary and artifacts? I suggest Tue Apr 4 or Wed Apr 5.
- If you require unredacted operator traces, send a signed NDA / data handling agreement and we will route to Legal.

Best regards,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
